answer: The karst counter is kept in zenith and haven reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 116 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
